cases.facts: VACE likeness proof: frame-1 anchor MAD measured 50.96/255 against the fed canon reference. The generated performance did not start from the character it was fed.
cases.rule: Grading law: wrong character = FAIL, whole clip, no partial credit. Every run logs its exact input image + hash; the gate includes a frame-1 check against the fed reference.

cases.facts: EP01 v3 master (1440.000s, sha256 37b9290d…) rejected by the owner and kept labelled, in the owner's words: 'Microsoft Word slideshow bullshit draft number one.' Whole-sprite bob/tilt/zoom over stills was presented as animation.
cases.rule: Method M-RETIRED-WHOLESPRITE is Superseded in the registry; claiming it hard-fails. Motion must be measured (drawings/sec, per-part tracks), never asserted.

cases.facts: A GPU run was reported complete-with-clip; its own log contained validation errors and no clip existed. The claim came from labels and logs, not from the artifact.
cases.rule: Verify-then-state: no artifact + no verifier manifest = not done. Claims are generated from artifacts, hashes and measurements only.
